prompt:
A designed desktop website UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, first viewport of KONSTANZ, a nightlife going-out guide for Konstanz. This is a website, not a photograph of a clipboard, not a poster, not a 3D render of an object.

STRUCTURE in order, top to bottom:
1) Slim 56px top nav on cool paper-white #F6F5F1: left wordmark KONSTANZ in condensed grotesque graphite #1B1D1F; right text links Discover (current, underlined hairline) Explore Weekend Saved. No buttons for create, profile, tickets, or sign in.
2) Directly under nav, a metal clipboard clip centered at the top edge of a full-width paper sheet that fills the remaining viewport. The sheet is laser-print paper #F6F5F1 with a faint aluminum edge #3A3D42. Hairline graphite rules, not cards, not shadows, not rounded rectangles.
3) On the sheet, a form masthead like a preprinted guest list: GUEST LIST · SAT 30 AUG · KONSTANZ in condensed grotesque. A small find-in-list field on the right of the masthead labeled Find. A quiet count My Weekend · 3 near the clip.
4) The sheet body is ROWS, not a card grid. Columns: TIME | TITLE | VENUE | DOOR. Hairline rules between rows.
   First row larger (featured): 23:00  TECHNO FRIDAY  Blechnerei  €8
   Second row: 22:00  Student Night  Club XYZ  €5 — this entire row has a highlighter yellow #E4F04A stroke through the title, the ONLY yellow on the entire screen (reserved for I'm going).
   Third: 21:00  Live Music Night  Bar Central  Free
   Fourth: 22:00  House Saturday  Kulturhaus  €5
   Fifth: 23:30  Hip-Hop Party  Hafenbar  €5
Times in condensed grotesque; titles and venues in a readable grotesque. NO serif, no Inter, no Bebas, no Playfair.
5) No hero banner, no slideshow, no category chips as the main event, no glassmorphism, no neon lime, no stacked shadow cards, no search-hero marketing block.

Palette only: paper #F6F5F1, graphite #1B1D1F, highlighter #E4F04A on the one saved row, stamp navy #1A365D only for the word Free or a tiny door stamp on the masthead. Cool light, kitchen/hallway lamp, not a dark club.

Visitor job must be readable: tonight's doors, times, prices. Photorealistic UI mock, browser window chrome optional but the page is the design.
